mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_user_id, revision FROM manga_project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND owner_user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_project SET revision = revision + 1, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{projectId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE manga_project_script_chapter SET revision = revision + 1, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chapterId} AND script_id IN (SELECT id FROM manga_project_script WHERE project_id = #{projectId})
